Moreover, this also cannot be a fight for a return to modernity (and so can't be a fight for a return of fate qua progress, as progress is a meme of liberalism), as that was a contingent, temporary phase of cultural logic that was best accommodated by the very thing (the unstable dynamic of liberalism) that necessarily leads to its subversion.

As such, any fight to return from post-modernity to modernity is a failed fight from the start, because it is fighting the inevitable result of liberalism... by appealing to liberalism. Post-modernity is now objective and post-idealogical, because all grand teleological narratives of history died when liberalism won. It is now facilitated by technology and forms the background of our cultural logic, in many ways the implicit terms we think in, and so the intersubjective space we all participate in.
